Ticket Id: 29228

Dr Ian Robson

Allergist

Central Hospital

Old town

17-06-2018

Dear Dr Robson,

RE: Mr Tom Riddle. DOB: 19-05-1998

I am writing to refer Mr Riddle, a 20-year-old student, whose features are consistent with bronchial
asthma.

Mr Riddle has a medical history of childhood asthma and periodic eczema. However, he did not record any       Comment [benchmark1]: have
asthmatic attack in the last 8 years. Moreover, he has a strong family history of bronchial asthma and IgA    Comment [benchmark2]: Please note,
nephropathy. He has no known allergies.

On 01-06-2018, Mr Riddle presented with a 2-week history of breathlessness associated with cough and
wheezing in addition to eye itching. His investigations showed a positive response to bronchodilator along
with a clear chest X-ray. Accordingly, oral prednisone, albuterol inhaler and Symbicort were prescribed. 2    Comment [benchmark3]: Change the
                                                                                                              paragraph here.
weeks later, his condition deteriorated. He complained of sleep disturbance despite taking albuterol 5 to 6
times every day. On examination, his respiratory rate was 32/minute and oxygen saturation was 88%. ABG        Comment [benchmark4]: a
revealed a low PaO2 level (62 mmHg). I detected bilateral diminished air entry with expiratory wheezing       Comment [benchmark5]: also
during auscultation. Accordingly, oxygen, albuterol and hydrocortisone were administered which improved
his condition.

On 17-06-2018, I discussed with Mr Riddle the environmental triggers as well as the proper inhaler
technique.

In view of the above, I would be grateful if you could arrange an allergic testing and provide advice         Comment [benchmark6]: allergy
regarding environmental management of Mr Riddle's condition.

For any queries, please contact me.

Yours sincerely,

Doctor
